title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 51
paragraphs: Meanwhile Demaratus son of Ariston had stayed behind in Sparta and was bringing charges against Cleomenes. He too was king of the Spartans, but of the inferior house—which, however, is inferior in no other way, since it is descended from the same ancestor; the house of Eurysthenes has always been honored more, apparently because he was the elder brother.
